svg.title: HYDRA-UMC-EDITOR-URDF architecture
svg.desc: HYDRA-UMC-EDITOR-URDF loads a URDF from GitHub or a folder into an in-house model tree, checks it against the 3 to 6 degrees of freedom of STUDIO, previews it with forward kinematics in OpenGL, and writes the tree back out or sends it to a HYDRA-UMC-SERVER.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI','Noto Sans','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Yu Gothic','Helvetica Neue',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif
'Segoe UI','Noto Sans','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Yu Gothic','Helvetica Neue',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif

svg.text: Parsing, feasibility, mesh loading and 3D preview are separate lanes around one model tree.
